name: apple-symbol-effects
about: Web re-creation of the SF Symbols animation presets shown on Apple's HIG SF Symbols page. Curves were MEASURED frame by frame from Apple's demo videos (sf-animation-*.mp4, 1634x400, 30 fps content) in a browser: bounding-box scale, ink-mass opacity, centroid offset and angular cross-correlation per symbol. Values are facts about motion (timings, scales), not Apple artwork. Keyframes are the measured samples; the runtime interpolates linearly between them (30 fps sampling = faithful curve).

tags.MEASURED: measured from Apple's HIG demo video frames (this repo's measurement, 2026-09-28)
tags.MEASURED-APPROX: measured, but the video mixes layers so the per-layer value is an estimate
tags.FIT: closed-form fit to measured samples (max error noted)
tags.CONV: our convention — Apple shows no video / number for it

units.t: seconds from effect start (keyframe offsets are t/duration)
units.scale: multiplier of the symbol's rest size, anchored at the symbol centre
units.opacity: multiplier of the layer's rest opacity
units.translate: fraction of the symbol's size (1 = one icon box)

appear.notes: Whole symbol reaches rest 0.20 s after the first layer shows; each layer grows from ~0.78x while fading in. Layer order follows the symbol's layer order (antenna: centre→outward; photo stack: front photo then the stack lines behind; waveform: leading→trailing).

disappear.notes: Much faster than appear: ~0.13 s, shrinks to ~0.87x while fading out.

bounce-up.notes: Peak 1.252x at 0.20 s, undershoot 0.908x at 0.43 s, rest at 0.567 s. Plays once. Opacity unchanged.

bounce-down.notes: Dip 0.748x at 0.20 s, overshoot 1.109x at 0.43 s, rest at 0.667 s.

scale-down.notes: Settles at 0.50x and stays until removed.

scale-up.notes: Settles at 1.25x and stays until removed.

pulse.notes: opacity multiplier = 0.75 + 0.25*cos(pi*t) (period 2.0 s): 1 → 0.5 → 1. Fit error ≤ 0.01 against 10 measured samples.

modes.iterative: layer i rises at i*step, falls right after; cycle = (n+2)*step (speaker n=3 → 1.67 s)
modes.cumulative: layer i rises at i*step and holds; all fall together after the last (CONV timing, same step)

variable-color.notes: Layer order = z-order (front-to-back) or reversed. Non-varying layers (the speaker body) stay at full opacity.

incoming.notes: New symbol starts at 0.5x, near-opaque within one frame, ease-out to 1x.

replace.notes: Outgoing and incoming do not overlap in the videos: the new symbol starts when the old one is gone.

slashDrawOn.notes: Slash grows from its top-leading end; reaches full length at ~0.33 s, overshoots ~4 % and settles by 0.5 s; the base symbol gets a gap cut along the slash.

badgeIn.notes: Badge scales from 0 with a spring: ~1.12x at 0.25 s, settles by ~0.75 s; base symbol opens a cut-out around the badge.

magic-replace.fallback: downUp replace when the two symbols are unrelated

translate.notes: offset × amplitude × icon size along the axis; first swing toward the named direction. Measured peak 0.050 of symbol height (vertical tray), 0.035 of symbol width / 0.057 of height (horizontal car).

rotate.notes: ±9.4° first swing, decays to 0 by 0.9 s.

breathe.notes: 1 → 1.20x and opacity 1 → ~0.29 at 1.5 s, back at 3.0 s; symmetric sine-like. Opacity is estimated from total ink (local stroke samples read lower because edges move).

rotate.notes: One clockwise turn in 2.0 s: fast start (peak ~400°/s at 0.3–0.4 s), long ease-out tail. Measured on the gear; by-layer rotation (fan blades, orbit dots) uses the same curve on the rotating layer only — the fan/orbit videos could not be tracked reliably (rotational symmetry aliasing).

draw-on.notes: SF Symbols 7 Draw On has no demo video on the page. Web version: stroke-dasharray/offset along each path, layers at once / staggered 0.08 s / one by one.

reducedMotion.rule: Accessibility + Motion pages: under prefers-reduced-motion, drop scale/translate/rotate. appear/disappear/replace → opacity crossfade 0.15 s; bounce/wiggle/rotate/breathe → no motion (state still shown); pulse/variable-color → static state (active layers full, inactive 0.3); scale → apply the end state instantly.
